currency_rule: one uppercase three-letter code per journal
journal_rule: at least one debit and one credit; totals equal
idempotency: same operation_id and same payload is a no-op; changed payload raises IdempotencyConflict
atomicity: journal header and postings inserted in one SQLite transaction
test_command: PYTHONPATH=. python -m pytest -q tests/ledger_contract tests/stage21 tests/stage25 tests/stage3 tests/stage33 tests/stage125
